name: Defending Lydia Collier
source:
Defending Lydia Collier is the story of a London-based lawyer called in to defend the wife of one of the city's most influential and wealthy businessmen who has recently disappeared.

You'll be with the defendant during police interviews through to the trial in court, working to review evidence and help build her case. Along the way you'll meet various other characters and experience the life of a currently single wealthy London lawyer.

Whether your fresh out of school assistant or a local police officer catches your eye, you'll be able to decide who you wish to interact with and choose to pursue romantically. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/whitephantomgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Defending Lydia Collier》讲述了一位伦敦律师的故事。城中一名最有权势、最富有的商人近日失踪，而这位律师受邀为他的妻子辩护。

从警方讯问到法庭审判，你将始终陪伴被告，审查证据，协助她准备辩护。在此过程中，你还会结识形形色色的人物，体验一位富裕、目前单身的伦敦律师的生活。

无论是刚毕业的助手，还是当地的一名警察令你心动，你都可以自行决定与谁来往，又要追求谁。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/whitephantomgames]Patreon[/url]]
